sentences.en: Have you heard of a bird called the Arctic Tern?
sentences.zh: 你听说过一种叫北极燕鸥的鸟吗？

sentences.en: The polar bear is the apex predator of the Arctic.
sentences.zh: 北极熊是北极的食物链顶端捕食者。

sentences.en: Michiko talks as if she had been to the Arctic herself.
sentences.zh: 美智子说话时就好像她自己去过北极一样。
